headlines: SPY 730.32 (-0.29%) at 12:05 ET per Stocktwits; Stocklake delayed quote 727.85 (-0.63%) shows an intraday dip toward 727 that has since bounced; QQQ -0.4%, IWM +0.35%, TLT +0.68%, GLD -2.9%
VIX 24.51 (from 23.81 last reading); fear & greed 24 'extreme fear' (from 26); breadth 7.4% oversold vs 3.2% overbought
UNH extends drop to -8.2% (357.70), trending #2 on Stocktwits; managed-care peers tagged; no confirmed cause found
NVDA -2.1% at 152.18, near day low 150.86; MSTR -4.7% (trending #1), ASTS -7.1%
Gainers: LULU +8.2%, TTWO +6.9%, PANW +6.2%; no confirmed catalysts found
Calendar: UK CPI 3.6% y/y; US retail sales (Nov 17) 0.2% m/m; no US key event today; Japan CPI 23:30Z

rumors.text: Posters say a new managed-care rule nicknamed 'CRUSH' is behind the UNH/HUM/MOH/CNC/ELV selloff (unconfirmed)
rumors.why: A regulatory hit to insurer payments would keep pressure on the whole managed-care group and S&P health care

rumors.text: NVDA posters fear Jensen Huang will not return as CEO (re-shared from last hour; unconfirmed)
rumors.why: Leadership uncertainty at the largest index weight weighs on SPY

rumors.text: Posters frame LULU's +8% as rotation out of AI names ('Burry winning, AI bubble investors crying'); one GEX post says LULU flipped to positive gamma above the 110 call wall
rumors.why: If money is rotating from AI megacaps to beaten-down consumer names, SPY lags while equal-weight/small caps hold up (IWM green)

rumors.text: SPY dip-buyers claim 727 is a level 'they won't let break'; others call the bounce a fake pump with lower highs
rumors.why: A hold of 727 would mark a short-term floor; a break would likely bring a faster drop

rumors.text: Bonds bid as money rotates to Treasuries (TLT +0.68%) while gold/silver sell off
rumors.why: Flight to safety tends to cap equity bounces

plays.reason: Lower highs, NVDA near day lows, UNH selloff accelerating (-6% to -8%), VIX up and bonds bid; offset by extreme fear (24), RSI ~37 and a bounce off ~727 with IWM green
plays.catalyst: NVDA leadership overhang and managed-care selloff

readings.whats_new: SPY dipped toward ~727 (Stocklake delayed -0.63%) then bounced back to 730.32 (-0.29%), about where it was an hour ago. UNH deepened to -8.2% with posters now blaming a managed-care rule; fear & greed slipped to 24 (extreme fear) and VIX rose to 24.5. LULU, TTWO and PANW lead gainers while MSTR tops Stocktwits trending.
